---
title: Hyperalgesia 
---


Hyperalgesia refers to an increased response to a stimulus that is normally painful @ballantyneBonicaManagementPain2019
Hyperalgesia: Nociceptive stimulus causes an excessive sensation of pain @bicalhoInhibitoryTestsAssessment2020


# Primary vs Secondary

**Primary hyperalgesia**: Hyperalgesia of the tissues that are causing afferent bombardment and neurogenic inflammation


**Secondary hyperalgesia**: Hyperalgesia of the tissues that converge on the same spinal cord segment/metamer/WDR but are *not* the primary source of stress @bicalhoInhibitoryTestsAssessment2020
